## Verdict

**Delta** is the strongest performer on level of profitability: the largest revenue base ($61.6B), the largest operating income ($6.0B), and the highest operating margin in the group (9.7%), with margin still expanding modestly.

**United is the closest challenger and the strongest on trajectory** — +21.0% operating income growth on +6.2% revenue growth, the biggest genuine (organic) margin expansion at +109 bps, narrowing the gap to Delta from 170 bps to 79 bps of margin. If the criterion were improvement rather than level, United wins.

The clear laggards: American was the only airline whose operating income *fell* (−13.8%, margin −93 bps) on the weakest revenue growth (+2.7%), and Southwest remains barely profitable at a 1.2% operating margin despite a 43% increase off a tiny base.
